articles.title: OKX Ventures buys $53 million stake in Korea's Coinone exchange
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange's investment arm and Korea Investment & Securities will each invest 80 billion won ($53 million) as Coinone pushes into stablecoins and tokenized securities.

articles.title: Tether's U.S.-focused stablecoin grows over 500% in a month, but still lags main rivals
articles.snippet: USAT's market cap jumped above $140 million in April, though it remains well behind Circle's USDC, PayPal's PYUSD and Ripple's RLUSD tokens.

articles.title: Trezor adds native USDt, USDC yield via Morpho integration
articles.snippet: The feature lets users earn stablecoin yield directly through Trezor Suite without connecting external wallets or using separate DeFi apps.

articles.title: ElevenLabs, Stability AI Drop New AI Music Models—Can They Catch Suno?
articles.snippet: Music v2 brings genre-shifting and section-by-section composition to ElevenLabs. Stable Audio 3.0 ships open weights and six-minute tracks. Is either good enough to dethrone the category leader?

articles.title: Cash App Now Supports Stablecoins, Despite Bitcoin Maxi Jack Dorsey's 'Gatekeeper' Gripes
articles.snippet: Cash App has begun supporting stablecoin transactions on networks including Ethereum and Solana, pushing past its Bitcoin-based roots.
